usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts, and Workiom keeps a list that gets a record when “Abandoned Checkout” runs “Create Record”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Record” in Workiom
bestTemplate.why: Each abandoned checkout becomes a record with the customer's email or phone, so you can follow up.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so records appear after a scheduled check, not at the moment of abandonment.
